remarks: Welcome to The Falls at Silvermine, where luxury meets natural tranquility. This exceptional, detached home offers a rare living experience, framed by the soothing sights and sounds of an overlooking waterfall. Inside, the home boasts an abundance of natural light anchored by two spectacular, floor-to-ceiling solariums-one off the main living room and the other creating a dreamlike retreat in the primary suite. Cozy up by any of the three wood-burning fireplaces, each beautifully finished with elegant stone veneer. Designed for effortless long-term living, the home features a freshly renovated kitchen and bathrooms, pristine refinished hardwood floors throughout, and extensive recent structural updates (including a new roof, gutters, and skylights) for total peace of mind. Outside, your private oasis awaits with an inviting in-ground pool and dedicated pool house-perfect for summer relaxation or entertaining. Discover a truly unique place to be home.
